expected_response.note: No registered bounded declarative edit is supported by the supplied evidence; the incumbent pointcloud program is retained unchanged.

failure_modes: An edit to pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend would be compiled as an operative change to the executing pointcloud scalar even though the supporting pair-kernel, moment and joint-motif effects are diagnostic only and absent from that scalar.

A time-conditioned teacher or regional-attention edit would be justified only by observed-node linear contrasts that the curve-fidelity audit largely rejected (legendre_runtime_allowed false; only 24 of the candidate curves selected), so it could shift coordinates without validated temporal support.

Narrowing or broadening teacher_neighbors would alter mode coverage with no supplied evidence of benefit and would risk unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates, which the reproducible negative joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A diagnostics flag as the concrete failure response.
Treating recorded joint-head survival credit as decoded terminal affinity would be unsupported because decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable.
rationale: D1.1: The only operative reward edit available in this lane is the executing pointcloud scalar R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau) with q the Hungarian mean squared endpoint distance and rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1); the formula registry states it has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term. The Analyst's strongest signed selection contrasts are pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5 (endpoint_effects:9-11, q 1.5e-4 to 9.8e-5, positive batch fraction 1.0) with pair_kernel_7.0 reversed (endpoint_effects:13), but no registered parameter maps onto a radial pair-distance shell density, so I cannot connect an operative edit to that hypothesis without treating a diagnostic feature as a force the formula does not contain. D1.2: The permitted time-conditioned alternatives (temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) reuse the same static teacher coordinates and only change regional attention at actual score nodes; the Analyst's continuous curves are observed-node linear interpolations over [0.0,0.49] with extrapolation disallowed, large sign-change counts and strong sign conflicts (continuous:0-19), and the curve-fidelity audit accepted only 24 curves with legendre_runtime_allowed false throughout (curve_support). A stationary coordinate target is therefore not distinguishable from a time-conditioned one on this evidence, and I do not read a temporal derivative as a spatial gradient. D2.1: The supplied spatial scales are the landmark coordinates in Angstrom and the pair-kernel shell radii 1.5-7.0 A with sigma 0.75 A; the observed short-range enrichment is a selection contrast, not a distance-response curvature the pointcloud scalar can express, and I do not infer teacher-mixture behavior from the intramolecular pair-distance statistic. D2.2: Intact-teacher dispersion is given by assignment_rms_A_quantiles [0.446, 0.863, 1.050] A with 28 teacher modes and teacher_neighbors=4 in the incumbent; narrower (2) or broader (8) neighborhoods would change mode coverage without any supplied evidence that the executing scalar benefits, and neighbor count is not a distance bandwidth, so I keep the fixed temperatures and supplied teacher provenance. D4.1: The incumbent already carries pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, mixture_temperature 0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0; the Analyst's reproducible effects are diagnostic (pair kernels, shape_yy, joint innovation/internal RMS, turnover residuals, survival credit) and none is an operative term of the executing reward, so no edit shows a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent. D4.2: The predicted failure response of an unsupported edit is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates: the joint-motion diagnostics are the most reproducible negative branch-adjusted effects (joint_innovation_RMS_A adjusted covariance -3.60e-5, q 0.020, same-sign batch fraction 0.929; joint_internal_RMS_A adjusted covariance -3.42e-5, q 0.030; branch_adjusted:151,153,305,307), and within-selector innovation aligns with the teacher contrast (+0.226, q 2.2e-9) rather than observed child score gain (-0.036, positive batch fraction 0.0; joint_diagnostics:1,2,11), so a dose or neighborhood change that increases joint innovation would move coordinates without an affinity-first justification. Retaining the incumbent is the affinity-first choice; no temperature edit is proposed or implied.
